name: Cubemap
signature: public sealed class Cubemap : Texture, ISerializable

docs.summary: A six-faced environment [`Texture`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Texture). Faces are square and indexed 0..5: +X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z, each with its top row first. Supports a full mip chain, such as a GGX prefiltered environment. Made with a layer count it is a cubemap array, a `samplerCubeArray` holding that many cubes, which lives only at runtime and is never saved.
Edge length of each (square) face, in texels.
How many cubes a cubemap array holds, 0 for a plain cubemap.
